summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Texas Mineral Resources Corp. (TMRC) via a two-step merger. Under the agreement dated March 4, 2026, each TMRC share was converted into 0.043279843 USAR shares, an exchange ratio based on 3,823,328 USAR shares divided by 88,339,693 TMRC fully diluted shares. TMRC stockholders received USAR common stock registered on Form S-4, with cash for fractional shares. The merger closed August 7, 2026, making TMRC a wholly owned subsidiary. This stock-for-stock deal was previously disclosed; no premium or break fee specified. Watch for post-closing integration and any dissenters' rights resolution.
